findings.text: The commit renames "Remaining work" to "Design reconciliation history", but the open instructions on lines 24-27 ("Implement the new production interface…") stay under it, so current to-do text reads as history. Fix: move lines 24-27 under "Implementation assignment" or "Pending", or mark them as the original plan.

The task's top mixes assignment-history text ("The API worker checked…", "Assignment source") into the header fields, and the same claims appear again in the status file. Fix: keep only the assignment date and source commit in the task header, and leave the worker narrative in the status file.
